description: This file is a test script for the `git merge-tree` command, containing numerous test cases verifying its functionality, output, and error handling across various scenarios including conflicts, renames, mode changes, and more.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for setup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timestamp to simulate time progression.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with setup and verification steps.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs, treating them as expected and actual results.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup command to run after the test.

methods.name: test_expect_id
methods.description: Verifies the output of an ID-generating command matches expectations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a test repository with specified options.

methods.name: lf_to_nul

methods.name: q_to_tab
